meta.title: RFQ: lower both lines (90 and 45)
gaps: Enter distinct revised prices of 90 for the first line and 45 for the second line in one revision
Verify that both individual line values changed from 100 and 50 to 90 and 45
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enter distinct revised prices of 90 for the first line and 45 for the second line in one revision; Verify that both individual line values changed from 100 and 50 to 90 and 45

steps.note: Open an existing live event with an active vendor bid; the catalog has no selector for the unnamed RFQ or its original 100/50 values.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the RFQ pricing round and its bid form.
Submit a revision using the supported single-price input; this verifies acceptance of a revision but cannot represent the second line's distinct price of 45.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the revised bid.
